verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a subscription-billing product, since self-hostable billing systems exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Chargebee can be deployed on user infrastructure. The docs describe a vendor-hosted REST API, hosted pages and Chargebee-hosted MCP servers. Custom MCP servers only let you pick which tools a server exposes; they do not self-host the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
